The position oversees project plans, resources, schedules, costs, risks, issues, changes, quality, documentation, and overall project performance while ensuring effective communication and timely decision-making throughout the project lifecycle. Key Responsibilities Lead projects from initiation and planning through execution, monitoring, completion, handover, and post-project review. Define project objectives, scope, deliverables, success criteria, milestones, timelines, dependencies, and key performance indicators. Develop comprehensive project plans covering activities, schedules, resources, budgets, procurement requirements, risks, quality requirements, and deliverables. Establish project milestones and monitor progress against approved schedules, deadlines, budgets, and performance targets. Coordinate internal departments, project teams, consultants, contractors, suppliers, vendors, and other third parties involved in project delivery. Assign responsibilities, coordinate workloads, monitor team performance, and ensure project tasks are completed according to agreed requirements. Ensure appropriate manpower, materials, equipment, technology, and other resources are available throughout the project lifecycle. Monitor project progress using appropriate schedules, dashboards, tracking systems, reports, and project management tools. Identify delays, dependencies, resource constraints, technical issues, and other obstacles and implement appropriate corrective actions. Manage project scope and ensure all deliverables remain aligned with approved objectives and requirements. Review and manage project changes, variations, change requests, and their potential impact on cost, schedule, resources, quality, and scope. Identify, assess, monitor, and mitigate project risks throughout the project lifecycle. Maintain risk registers, issue logs, action trackers, decision registers, change records, and other project-control documentation. Escalate significant risks, issues, delays, budget concerns, and project decisions to senior management or relevant stakeholders when required. Develop, monitor, and control project budgets, forecasts, expenditures, commitments, and overall cost performance. Coordinate with Finance, Procurement, Commercial, and other relevant departments regarding project costs, purchase orders, contracts, invoices, and financial documentation. Support procurement activities including supplier selection, quotations, contracts, materials, equipment, services, and delivery requirements. Monitor contractor, consultant, supplier, and vendor performance against contractual obligations, schedules, quality standards, and agreed deliverables. Review project documentation, technical submissions, reports, drawings, specifications, schedules, and other deliverables where applicable. Ensure project activities comply with approved specifications, quality requirements, company policies, contractual obligations, safety standards, and applicable regulations. Establish and monitor quality-control processes to ensure project deliverables meet required standards and stakeholder expectations. Coordinate inspections, testing, commissioning, implementation, acceptance, handover, and close-out activities where applicable. Conduct regular project meetings, progress reviews, coordination sessions, and stakeholder discussions. Act as a primary point of contact for project-related communication with clients, stakeholders, management, vendors, contractors, and internal departments. Prepare project reports, dashboards, presentations, meeting minutes, progress updates, and management summaries. Manage stakeholder expectations and ensure project requirements, decisions, responsibilities, and deadlines are clearly communicated and documented. Resolve project-related conflicts, coordination issues, resource constraints, and operational challenges in a timely and professional manner. Maintain complete and accurate project documentation throughout the project lifecycle. Ensure project teams follow established project management methodologies, governance procedures, approval processes, and reporting requirements. Monitor project performance against agreed KPIs and identify opportunities for improvement. Implement appropriate project-management methodologies such as Waterfall, Agile, hybrid, or other approaches according to project requirements. Coordinate project handover and ensure all required documentation, deliverables, approvals, training, outstanding items, and acceptance requirements are completed. Conduct post-project reviews and capture lessons learned, improvement opportunities, and best practices for future projects. Identify opportunities to improve project processes, resource utilization, cost efficiency, delivery performance, and stakeholder satisfaction. Maintain strong working relationships with all project stakeholders and promote effective collaboration throughout the project. Ensure projects are completed professionally, efficiently, safely, and in accordance with approved business and operational objectives. Requirements Bachelor's Degree in Project Management, Business Administration, Engineering, Information Technology, Construction Management, Operations Management, or a related discipline is preferred. Proven experience in project management, project coordination, programme delivery, operations, engineering, construction, IT, or another relevant project-based environment. Demonstrated experience managing projects from planning and initiation through execution, monitoring, delivery, and closure. Strong knowledge of project planning, scheduling, resource management, budgeting, cost control, risk management, quality management, and change control. Experience developing project plans, schedules, milestones, resource plans, budgets, risk registers, and project reports. Strong understanding of project scope management, requirements management, dependencies, deliverables, and project governance. Proven ability to coordinate cross-functional teams and manage internal and external stakeholders effectively. Strong leadership skills with the ability to assign responsibilities, motivate project teams, manage performance, and resolve conflicts. Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, stakeholder-management, and interpersonal skills. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with a structured and proactive approach to identifying and resolving project issues. Good financial and commercial awareness, including experience monitoring project budgets, costs, forecasts, contracts, procurement, and supplier performance. Experience managing contractors, consultants, suppliers, vendors, or third-party service providers is an advantage. Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint, and project management tools such as Microsoft Project, Primavera P6, Jira, Asana, Monday.com, or other relevant platforms. Ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, stakeholders, and projects in a fast-paced environment. PMP, PRINCE2, CAPM, Scrum, Agile, or other relevant project management certification is an advantage.
